what_it_does: Logistic regression: adds up weighted points for each detail of a deal (product, sector, agent and so on) and turns the total into a win probability. Very cautious setting: it barely trusts any single detail.

accuracy_verdict: Same as predicting the average win rate

what_it_does: Gradient boosting: builds many small decision trees in a row. Each asks a few yes-or-no questions about a deal and corrects the earlier trees' mistakes. The result is a win probability. 100 trees, 2 questions deep, learning slowly.
ranking_verdict: Slightly better than a coin flip, too little to act on
